items.label: Tall Plant Support Stakes
items.value: Set of 10pcs, 10" Wide x 24" High, great tall plant stakes for flowers, peonies, monstera, cone flowers, tomato plants, orchid, rose, and pepper, indoor potted plants, bushy plants, tall outdoor plants etc.

items.label: Sturdy material and powder coating
items.value: HiGift half round plant stakes made of sturdy iron wire in 4mm thick with powder coating, it is better than others that in cheap plastic coated. powder coating will last long time even using under sun and rain. 4mm thick steel make it is sturdy and hard to bend, can well support different plants.

items.label: Natural Appearance
items.value: The dark green surface means they're basically invisible against the leaves.

items.label: Smart Half Round Design Tall Plant Support
items.value: half round design make it easy to fit around the plants, just attach 2pcs together to support your potted plant. Also it can be linked in a grouping to be however big you need.

items.label: Wide Applications
items.value: 24inch extended length plant supports can fit most bushy plants like hydrangeas, roses, peonies, salvias, cone flowers, etc. tomato plants and vine plants like cherry tomato, etc. Well props up plants to grow upright and healthily. Also can be used as border to keep pathways open in your garden.

items.label: Recommended Uses for Product
items.value: Supporting plants (flowers, peonies, monstera, tomato plants, hydrangeas, etc.) and maintaining garden pathways
